title: Logs
description: Search the log entries that Semantic Logger sends. Filter by text or by request id.

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ServiceName FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY ServiceName
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT ServiceName FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY ServiceName

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, SeverityText AS level, count() AS entries
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR Body ILIKE concat('%', ${search:sqlstring}, '%')
       OR LogAttributes['exception.message'] ILIKE concat('%', ${search:sqlstring}, '%'))
  AND (${request_id:sqlstring} = '' OR LogAttributes['request_id'] = ${request_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY time, level
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Errors by exception

targets.rawSql:
SELECT LogAttributes['exception.type'] AS exception, count() AS errors, max(Timestamp) AS last_seen,
       any(LogAttributes['exception.message']) AS example_message
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR Body ILIKE concat('%', ${search:sqlstring}, '%')
       OR LogAttributes['exception.message'] ILIKE concat('%', ${search:sqlstring}, '%'))
  AND (${request_id:sqlstring} = '' OR LogAttributes['request_id'] = ${request_id:sqlstring}) AND SeverityNumber >= 17 AND LogAttributes['exception.type'] != ''
GROUP BY exception
ORDER BY errors DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.description: Error and fatal entries that carry an exception, by exception.type.

panels.title: Top loggers

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ScopeName AS logger, count() AS entries,
       countIf(SeverityNumber >= 13) AS warnings_and_errors
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR Body ILIKE concat('%', ${search:sqlstring}, '%')
       OR LogAttributes['exception.message'] ILIKE concat('%', ${search:sqlstring}, '%'))
  AND (${request_id:sqlstring} = '' OR LogAttributes['request_id'] = ${request_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY logger
ORDER BY entries DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.description: Log entries by logger name, the instrumentation scope of each record.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Timestamp AS timestamp,
       if(Body != '', Body, concat(LogAttributes['exception.type'], ': ', LogAttributes['exception.message'])) AS body,
       SeverityText AS level, ScopeName AS logger,
       LogAttributes AS attributes
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR Body ILIKE concat('%', ${search:sqlstring}, '%')
       OR LogAttributes['exception.message'] ILIKE concat('%', ${search:sqlstring}, '%'))
  AND (${request_id:sqlstring} = '' OR LogAttributes['request_id'] = ${request_id:sqlstring})
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 500
